lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: Someone's been here recently. These markings are fresh.
lines.lens: Chalk on stone. Precise lines. Not graffiti — notation. Someone is studying this place.

lines.speaker: Lex
lines.text: Please don't step on the grid. It took four hours.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.monologue: Sitting cross-legged by the wall. Notebooks everywhere. He hasn't looked up yet.

lines.speaker: Lex
lines.text: The floor pattern here matches three different historical periods layered on top of each other. It's quite unusual. Also I haven't eaten since yesterday, if that's relevant to whatever's about to happen.

lines.speaker: Rynn
lines.text: It is. Here.
lines.monologue: She's already pulling dried fruit from her pack. She does this. Feeds people without being asked. Probably doesn't think of it as kindness.

lines.speaker: Lex
lines.text: Thank you. I'm Lex. Velundrath Cultural Preservation Society, though the society part is somewhat aspirational at this point.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: You study ruins?

lines.speaker: Lex
lines.text: I study the people who built them. The ruins are just the part that didn't leave.
lines.monologue: He speaks about dead civilizations the way some people talk about friends they've lost touch with. Not sad. Just... aware of the distance.

lines.speaker: Caelan
lines.text: Can you read these markings?

lines.speaker: Lex
lines.text: Some of them. This section is a record of seasonal observations. That section is a prayer cycle. And that part I genuinely can't figure out — which is why I've been sitting here for four hours without eating.

lines.speaker: Caelan
lines.text: The part you can't read. It's not a language. It's a threshold marker. Something was sealed here.
lines.monologue: He said it without thinking. Like remembering how to breathe.

lines.speaker: Lex
lines.text: How do you know that?

lines.speaker: Caelan
lines.text: I don't know how I know it.

lines.speaker: Lex
lines.text: That's... actually more interesting than if you did know.
lines.monologue: He's looking at Caelan the way he looked at the ruins. Not studying. Recognizing something worth understanding.

lines.speaker: Lex
lines.text: I've been working alone for seven months. It's not sustainable and my notes are getting circular. If you're traveling and encountering old places, I'd like to come along.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: We attract trouble.

lines.speaker: Lex
lines.text: I know. I found your campfire ash from two nights ago. You also attract attention from the kind of places I want to study. It's a reasonable exchange.
lines.monologue: He's already packing his notebooks. Organized. Methodical. He decided three sentences ago and spent the rest of the time being polite about it.

choices.text: Another person to feed. Another person to protect.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: Welcome aboard, then.
lines.monologue: He knows things we need to know. And he's survived alone here for seven months. That's not nothing.

lines.speaker: Lex
lines.text: Thank you. Please don't step on the grid on your way out.
lines.monologue: He said it like someone who has just been given something he didn't expect and is covering the weight of it with manners.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: Another person to feed. Another person to protect.
lines.monologue: I said it aloud so it would sound as small as it was. The real objection — that I'm collecting people I'll have to keep alive — I kept to myself.
lines.lens: Current provisions: twelve days at four. Nine days at five. Manageable. Barely.

lines.speaker: Lex
lines.text: I forage. I cook, passably. And I don't need protecting — I need company. There's a difference.
lines.monologue: He didn't look hurt. He looked like someone who has had to justify his own usefulness before and has made peace with the exercise.

lines.speaker: Rynn
lines.text: Take him, Zi. Anyone who survives seven months alone in ruins and his biggest complaint is circular notes — that's someone worth having.
lines.monologue: She'd already made room in the walking order. Logistics mind. Always three steps ahead.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: Fine. But watch the grid on your way out.
